text: Button attempted to find out a north-well pallage to the Call Indies. It lies between 80° and 100° W, long, and between 60° and 60° N. lat.

parsed.faithful: Button attempted to find out a north-weft paffage to the Eaft Indies. It lies between 80° and 100° W. long. and between 60° and 66° N. lat.
parsed.modern: Button attempted to find out a north-west passage to the East Indies. It lies between 80° and 100° W. long. and between 60° and 66° N. lat.
